name: Water
description: The most common laboratory solvent used in chemical reactions and solution preparation.
hazards: No significant hazard under normal laboratory conditions
disposal: Can generally be disposed of through normal laboratory drainage if uncontaminated.

name: Ethanol
description: A widely used organic solvent in laboratories and pharmaceutical industries.
storage: Store in a flammable chemical cabinet away from ignition sources.
first_aid: Move to fresh air if inhaled. Flush eyes with water if exposed.

name: Methanol
description: A toxic organic solvent commonly used in laboratories and industry.
storage: Store in a flammable storage cabinet.
first_aid: Seek immediate medical attention after exposure.
environmental_impact: Can contaminate water if improperly disposed.

name: Isopropyl Alcohol
description: A common laboratory cleaning solvent and disinfectant.
storage: Store away from heat and open flames.
first_aid: Wash exposed area with water and move to fresh air if inhaled.

name: Acetone
description: A fast-evaporating solvent widely used for cleaning and chemical reactions.
first_aid: Move to fresh air and flush eyes with water if exposed.

name: Benzene
description: An aromatic solvent used in laboratories but limited due to its carcinogenic nature.
storage: Store in a flammable chemical cabinet.
first_aid: Seek immediate medical attention after exposure.
green_alternative: Toluene or greener solvents where appropriate.
environmental_impact: Hazardous to human health and the environment.

name: Toluene
description: An aromatic solvent commonly used in paints, coatings, and laboratories.
first_aid: Move to fresh air and seek medical advice if symptoms persist.
environmental_impact: Can pollute air and water if improperly handled.

name: Hexane
description: A non-polar solvent used in extraction and laboratory analysis.
hazards: May damage nerves after prolonged exposure
storage: Store in a flammable storage cabinet.
first_aid: Move to fresh air and seek medical attention if symptoms develop.
green_alternative: Heptane or bio-based solvents where practical.
environmental_impact: Harmful to aquatic life if released in large amounts.

name: Ethyl Acetate
description: A colorless, fruity-smelling solvent widely used in laboratories, coatings, and pharmaceuticals.
storage: Store in a cool, well-ventilated flammable storage cabinet.
first_aid: Move to fresh air and rinse eyes with water if exposed.
green_alternative: Considered a relatively greener organic solvent.
environmental_impact: Biodegradable but contributes to VOC emissions.

name: Chloroform
description: A chlorinated solvent used in laboratories for extraction and research.
storage: Store in tightly sealed amber bottles away from heat.
first_aid: Move to fresh air immediately and seek medical attention.
disposal: Dispose as hazardous halogenated solvent waste.
green_alternative: Use ethyl acetate or other safer solvents when suitable.

name: Diethyl Ether
description: A volatile solvent commonly used in extraction and organic synthesis.
storage: Store in tightly sealed containers away from light and ignition sources.
first_aid: Move to fresh air and seek medical attention if necessary.
green_alternative: Use safer extraction solvents where possible.

name: Dimethyl Sulfoxide
description: A polar solvent widely used in biological and pharmaceutical research.
hazards: May carry dissolved chemicals through the skin
storage: Store tightly sealed at room temperature.
first_aid: Wash exposed skin thoroughly with water.
green_alternative: Often considered a safer polar solvent.
environmental_impact: Low environmental impact when properly handled.

name: Acetonitrile
description: A polar solvent commonly used in chromatography and analytical laboratories.
storage: Store in a flammable storage cabinet.
first_aid: Seek immediate medical attention after exposure.
environmental_impact: Can contaminate water if improperly disposed.

name: Cyclohexane
description: A non-polar solvent used in laboratories and industrial applications.
storage: Store away from heat and open flames.
first_aid: Move to fresh air if inhaled.

name: Xylene
description: An aromatic solvent used in laboratories, paints, and histology.
first_aid: Move to fresh air and seek medical attention if symptoms occur.
green_alternative: Use limonene-based or other greener solvents where appropriate.
environmental_impact: Can pollute air and water if improperly handled.
